baked_motion.note: idle_a already has chest-bounce-3 baked into the pixels (pigtails/hip/tail were not re-warped in that bake). Layer pivots move with that baked motion. Engine springs should be added on top only as extra bounce (see docs/CHEST_BOUNCE.md baked_layer), or used in place of the bake after a rebake; do not double the same motion at 100% intensity.

layers.role: body, head, arms, outfit, tail; chest and pigtail footprints inpainted with slack fill

layers.motion: translation around pivot (vertical bounce + optional squash)
layers.role: covered upper torso and bust with her top on, opaque, same coverage as the source

layers.motion: translation + small rotation about the root at the head
layers.role: screen-left pigtail (hair + tie); scalp, bangs, horns and face stay on base

layers.motion: translation + small rotation about the root at the head
layers.role: screen-right pigtail (hair + tie); scalp, bangs, horns and face stay on base

body_hints_note: Per-frame torso_anchor is a midriff point just below the bust (not the bouncing chest). torso_delta_px is the wrap-around delta from the previous frame; vel/acc use central differences on the loop, units px/s and px/s^2, +y down. Drive chest/pigtail springs from torso_acc (and/or torso_vel) so bounce ramps up with body motion. chest_pivot_* includes baked chest bounce; baked_chest_offset_px is the chest-bounce-3 bake residual.

composite_exactness.goal: zero-offset over() composite matches the shipped frame within 1 level

engine_notes.channels: Existing lillith-core springs: Channel::Chest ('chest') and Channel::Pigtail ('pigtails'/'pigtail'/'pig'). Attachment signs match assets/physics.toml: pigtail_left sign -1, pigtail_right sign +1. feat/layered-jiggle-physics had no unique layer format yet (branch pointed at origin/main 1184b90d with no extra commits); this schema is the proposed input.
engine_notes.consume: Load the four sheets, composite in z_order with over(), apply spring offsets as translations (and pigtail rotation) about the per-frame pivot. At zero offsets the result must match the current atlas cell. Do not change manifest.toml to enable this; a clip-json 'layers' pointer is enough for a later importer.
